reasoning: The icon combines a large checkmark with three horizontal list bars, clearly signifying a checklist or task list. Because it appears inside a to-do app where everything is already a task, it is only useful when the task itself is explicitly about creating, reviewing, or running through a checklist (like a packing list, pre-flight checklist, or GTD backlog review), rather than any generic task starting with 'check'.

readings.meaning: complete all items / check off list

pass1.ambiguity: Can be confused with a generic 'done' checkmark or a 'fast checkmark' (speed lines) if the bars are read as motion trails rather than list lines; also very generic inside a task manager where every item is already a task.
